message: BLOCKING adversarial review on PR #2817 exact head 182dd4b97a121c13fc9c99d3b5c078b6267d3652: PropulsionEnergyRailSimulatorRuntime is public and its public acceptLiveSource/retainSource APIs accept caller-provided watts + receiptSequenceNumber + uptime + continuityGeneration, then mint PropulsionPowerSample.simulator. An arbitrary NembraCore importer can therefore create accepted Simulator propulsion authority without the source-file-sealed SimulatorPowerObservation/SimulatorPowerEvidenceAvailability emitted by SimulatedScooterService. Review 4904145233 records the required repair: mechanically seal positive runtime admission to genuine source custody and add an adversarial external-consumer/API test. Current-main NembraCore product linkage was separately verified, so project source visibility is not the blocker. This finding is Simulator software authority only and does not change physical ES80 truth or Capture NO-GO.
